observed: These results describe six inspected samples (3 conditions x seeds 0417, 0418) of one engine: 'kit.py procedural animatic' = stage.py + rig.py at generator_rev 6735b7d7e7a7.
Seeds are repeatable in this engine: frames 0, 29, 132 of all six samples re-render byte-identically in a fresh process (True).

In this engine the seed governs only unprotected elements (runner count 7 vs 8, positions, phases, idle holds, print grain); protected masks are identical across seeds on all 168 frames, side and plan (True).
The treatment field changed fill only (puppet outline IoU min 1.0000).
The camera field changed projection and lost anchors ['A-neck', 'A4c', 'A5v', 'A6', 'A6w']; partially kept ['A-hat', 'A0', 'A1', 'A5', 'A5d', 'A7', 'A8'].
not_claimed: Nothing here is evidence about text-to-video or text-to-image generators in general, or about how Martino's own generator handled seeds, fixed actions or prompt deltas; the film is a stand-in engine whose isolation of seed streams is built in by design (P4).
An intended-effect rate of n of 2 is a count over two inspected samples, not an estimate of a probability.
The counterexample shows this harness detects one class of drift (projector drawing from a shared stream); it does not prove absence of other drift classes.
